```python
def parse_footnote_item(block: 'BlockParser', key: str, index: int, state:
    BlockState) ->Dict[str, Any]:
    ref_footnotes = state.env.get('ref_footnotes', {})
    text = ref_footnotes.get(key, '')
    
    # Parse the footnote text as block content
    child_state = BlockState()
    child_state.process(text)
    block.parse(child_state)
    
    return {
        'type': 'footnote_item',
        'children': child_state.tokens,
        'attrs': {'key': key, 'index': index}
    }
```
